parameters.description:
Specifies how the character code is handled.

ASCII: Read as an ASCII code in decimal (32-125), 31 turns all segments on.

Custom: Read as an integer (0-65535). Interpreted as an unsigned 16-bit binary number which determines which segment(s) to turn on (e.g. 4635 = 'M').
